# Public API inventory

<!-- Generated by `make api-docs` from api/openapi.yaml. Do not edit. -->

Every operation an API key (`Authorization: Bearer msk_…`) can call. The interactive
reference with request/response examples and code samples is served by each
installation at `/docs/api`; the machine-readable document at `/api/v1/openapi.json`.
Paths are relative to `/api/v1`. **Scope**: any one of the listed scopes is enough.

77 operations.

## Messaging

### Messages

| Method | Path | Summary | Scope | Rate limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/media` | Upload a file to send as an image, video, audio, document or sticker | `messages.send` | 300/min per key |
| POST | `/messages` | Queue a WhatsApp message | `messages.send` | 300/min per key |
| GET | `/messages/{messageId}` | A message and its delivery state | `messages.send` | 300/min per key |

### Conversations

| POST | `/conversations/{conversationId}/messages` | Send a message in the conversation | `conversations.reply` | 300/min per key |

| POST | `/conversations/{conversationId}/takeover` | Take the conversation over from the AI or the pool | `conversations.reply` | 300/min per key |
